title: Live sessions
description: Run a quiz in class: students join with a code on their phones and answer in real time.
newSessionHint: Use questions from a published assessment, or let the AI write a quick set on a topic.
fromAi: A quick AI set on a topic
noPublishedAssessments: Publish an assessment first to use its questions, or choose a quick AI set.
topicHint: For example: the water cycle, for grade 6.
gameModeHint: Points for correct and fast answers, streaks and a leaderboard.
noSessionsHint: Create one above and share the code with your class.
actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
endBody: Students can no longer answer. The results stay saved.
waitingForParticipants: Share the code. Start becomes available when someone has joined.
uniqueQuestionsNote: Each student has their own question. Answered: {{answered}}, correct: {{correct}}.
noParticipantsHint: Students open the join page and type the code.
removeBody: {{name}} will leave the session and their answers will not count.
qrAlt: QR code to join the session with code {{code}}
studentPacedProgress: Everyone is working at their own pace
joinSubtitle: Type the 6-digit code your teacher shows.
codeUnknown: No open session has this code.
notStartedYet: The session has not started yet.
inProgress: The session is in progress. You will join at the current question.
nicknameHint: The name your teacher and class will see.
anonymousNames: You will get an anonymous name in this session.
guestNote: Guests can take part in live sessions only. Graded exams need an account.
removedBody: The teacher removed you from this session.
expiredBody: Your place in this session could not be found on this device.
waitingForTeacher: Wait for your teacher to start.
waitForOthers: Your teacher will end the session when everyone is done.
getReady: Get ready for the first question…
pausedBody: Your teacher paused the question. The timer has stopped.
answerReceived: Answer received. Wait for your teacher to show the correct answer.
noAnswerGiven: You did not answer this question.
teamsHint: Students are spread over the teams automatically; you can move them.
quickPollHint: Ask the class anything; results update live. Polls are not graded.
anonymousPollHint: You will see the answers but not who gave them.
exitTicketHint: Three short questions at the end of the lesson, in the session's language: how well students understood, one thing they learned, and one question for you.
exitUnderstanding: How well did you understand today's lesson?
pollIsAnonymous: This poll is anonymous: your teacher will not see your name.
